event.title: South Korea to Recall Ambassador to Ukraine Amid North Korean POW Dispute
event.canonical_title: South Korea to Recall Ambassador to Ukraine Amid North Korean POW Dispute
event.summary: South Korea has announced the recall of its ambassador to Ukraine following a diplomatic dispute over the public disclosure of the transfer of two North Korean prisoners of war. The South Korean government expressed concerns that this revelation could endanger the prisoners' families in North Korea and has demanded an apology from Ukraine, which has not been forthcoming. The situation escalated after South Korean President Lee Jae Myung threatened unspecified punitive measures if Ukraine does not respond.

timeline.title: South Korea to Recall Ambassador to Ukraine Amid North Korean POW Dispute
timeline.summary: South Korea has announced it will recall its ambassador to Ukraine due to a dispute over the public disclosure of North Korean prisoners of war at the UN. The decision follows South Korea's demand for an apology from Ukraine, which has not been received. In response, Ukraine expressed its willingness to engage in 'constructive dialogue' despite the diplomatic tensions.
key_facts: South Korea will recall its ambassador to Ukraine.

Ukraine is open to constructive dialogue despite the tensions.
